description: Like the World Tree Yggdrasil binding many realms, Kubernetes 1.35 'Timbernetes' grows ring by ring through community care. In-place pod resource resize graduates to GA for nondisruptive vertical scaling, gang scheduling arrives in alpha for AI/ML workloads, and pod certificates simplify zero-trust architectures. Three squirrels guard the tree: reviewers with LGTM scrolls, release crews with axes, and triagers with lanterns.

urgentUpgradeNotes.title: cgroup v1 support removed
urgentUpgradeNotes.description: Kubelet will fail to start on nodes without cgroup v2. This has been deprecated since 1.31.
urgentUpgradeNotes.action: Ensure all nodes are running with cgroup v2 before upgrading to 1.35

urgentUpgradeNotes.title: containerd 1.x support deprecated
urgentUpgradeNotes.description: containerd 1.7 reaches EOL. Support will be removed in 1.36.

features.title: In-place Update of Pod Resources
features.description: Allows adjusting CPU and memory resources without restarting Pods or Containers
features.impact: Smoother vertical scaling, less disruption for stateful/batch workloads

features.title: Gang Scheduling
features.description: All-or-nothing scheduling for pod groups via Workload API
features.impact: Prevents partial scheduling deadlocks for AI/ML training jobs

features.title: Pod Certificates for Workload Identity
features.description: Native workload identity with automated certificate rotation via PodCertificateRequest
features.impact: Simplifies mTLS and zero-trust architectures without external controllers

features.title: Node Declared Features Before Scheduling
features.description: Nodes declare supported features via status.declaredFeatures for compatibility checks
features.impact: Prevents scheduling pods to incompatible older nodes during upgrades

features.title: PreferSameNode Traffic Distribution
features.description: Services can prefer endpoints on local node, with PreferSameZone replacing PreferClose
features.impact: Reduced latency, explicit control over traffic routing

features.title: Job API Managed-by Mechanism
features.description: Jobs can delegate status sync to external controllers via managedBy field
features.impact: Enables MultiKueue and other multi-cluster job dispatching systems

features.title: Pod Generation Tracking
features.description: Pods now have metadata.generation and status.observedGeneration fields
features.impact: Reliable way to verify kubelet processed Pod spec changes

features.title: maxUnavailable for StatefulSets
features.description: StatefulSets can update multiple pods simultaneously during rolling updates
features.impact: Faster updates for stateful apps that tolerate multiple pods down

features.title: User Namespaces in Pods
features.description: Pods run with isolated UID/GID mappings, root inside maps to unprivileged on host
features.impact: Reduced privilege escalation risk, safer container root

features.title: OCI Images as Volume Source
features.description: Mount OCI container images as read-only volumes in Pods
features.impact: Separate data from app images, no init containers needed

bugFixes.title: Fixed scheduler crash when using pod topology spread with empty selector
Fixed kubelet memory leak when using projected volumes
Fixed kube-proxy not updating endpoints after Service port change

deprecations.reason: cgroup v2 is the modern standard

removals.reason: Kubelet will fail to start on nodes without cgroup v2

apiChanges.description: New Workload API for gang scheduling
Defines a group of pods that must be scheduled together

references.title: Kubernetes v1.35: Timbernetes (The World Tree Release)
